userStories.title: Extend S/R to 30-day candles and add 4h fallback in support_resistance.py
userStories.description:
Current state: support_resistance.py at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/support_resistance.py requires minimum 2 swing lows and 1 swing high from daily candles. 27% of tokens (984 of 3605 evaluations) are disqualified with 'no_sr_data' because 14-day daily candles don't produce enough swing points for small-cap tokens.

GeckoTerminal already returns 30 days of daily candles by default. The issue is that even with 30 candles, some tokens don't have enough price structure for swing detection with lookback=3.

What to build:
1. Add a calculate_sr_with_fallback(daily_candles, hourly_candles=None, lookback=3) function:
   - First try: calculate_sr(daily_candles, lookback=3) using all available candles
   - If that returns None AND hourly_candles is provided:
     - Try calculate_sr(hourly_candles, lookback=3) — more data points, more swing points
   - If still None AND daily_candles has >= 7 candles:
     - Try calculate_sr(daily_candles, lookback=2) — reduced lookback catches more swings
   - If still None AND hourly_candles provided with >= 20 candles:
     - Try calculate_sr(hourly_candles, lookback=2)
   - Return None only if all attempts fail
   - Include a 'sr_source' key in the returned dict: 'daily_3', 'hourly_3', 'daily_2', 'hourly_2'

2. Modify calculate_sr() to accept minimum swing lows = 1 (currently requires 2):
   - When only 1 swing low exists, use it as support directly (no averaging)
   - Still require at least 1 swing high for resistance
   - Add 'swing_count': {'lows': N, 'highs': N} to the returned dict
   - Lower swing count = lower confidence in the levels, which signal_filter.py can optionally use

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify run_pipeline.py, signal_filter.py, or any other file
- Keep the existing calculate_sr() function signature unchanged (backward compatible)
- The new calculate_sr_with_fallback() is an additional function that run_pipeline.py will call instead
- No API calls in this module — it only processes data passed in
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts'); from support_resistance import calculate_sr_with_fallback; print('import OK')"

python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts'); from support_resistance import calculate_sr; import random; random.seed(42); candles=[{'timestamp':i*86400,'open':1.0+random.uniform(-0.1,0.1),'high':1.1+random.uniform(0,0.1),'low':0.9+random.uniform(-0.1,0),'close':1.0+random.uniform(-0.05,0.05),'volume':10000} for i in range(30)]; r=calculate_sr(candles); print(f'SR result: {r is not None} PASS')"
userStories.notes: Implemented US-001: Added calculate_sr_with_fallback() function that tries multiple strategies (daily_3, hourly_3, daily_2, hourly_2) in order, returning sr_source to indicate which succeeded. Modifie
